arxiv-1805-11824.title: Anaphora and Coreference Resolution: A Review Journal: Artificial Intelligence Review
arxiv-1805-11824.creator: Rhea Sukthanker, Soujanya Poria, Erik Cambria, Ramkumar Thirunavukarasu
arxiv-1805-11824.description: Abstract Entity resolution aims at resolving repeated references to an entity in a document and forms a core component of natural language processing (NLP) research. This field possesses immense potential to improve the performance of other NLP fields like machine translation, sentiment analysis, paraphrase detection, summarization, etc.

arxiv-2102-09721.title: Approximations in transmon simulation
arxiv-2102-09721.creator: Tyler Jones 1,2,3,∗, Kaiah Steven 1, Xavier Poncini 1, Matthew Rose 1, Arkady Fedorov 2,3
arxiv-2102-09721.description: Abstract Classical simulations of time-dependent quantum systems are widely used in quantum control research. In particular, these simulations are commonly used to host iterative optimal control algorithms. This is convenient for algorithms which are too onerous to run in the loop with current-day quantum hardware, as well as for researchers without consistent access to hardware.

arxiv-2104-11667.title: Deep Learning for Bayesian Optimization of Scientific Problems with High-Dimensional Structure
arxiv-2104-11667.creator: Samuel Kim samkim@mit.edu, Peter Y. Lu, Charlotte Loh, Jamie Smith, Jasper Snoek, Marin Soljačić soljacic@mit.edu
arxiv-2104-11667.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Samuel Kim samkim@mit.edu, Peter Y. Lu, Charlotte Loh, Jamie Smith, Jasper Snoek, Marin Soljačić soljacic@mit.edu. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular paradigm for global optimization of expensive black-box functions, but there are many domains where the function is not completely a black-box. The data may have some known structure (e.g. symmetries) and/or the data generation process may be a composite process that yields useful intermediate or auxiliary information in addition to the value of the optimization objective.

Ron Aharoni is Supported by the Israel Science Foundation (ISF) grant no. 2023464 and the Discount Bank Chair at the Technion. This paper is part of a project that has received funding from the Eu
arxiv-2107-12881.creator: Ron Aharoni, Joseph Briggs
arxiv-2107-12881.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ron Aharoni, Joseph Briggs. This is a survey paper on rainbow sets (another name for “choice functions”). The main theme is the distinction between two types of choice functions: those having a large (in the sense of belonging to some specified filter, namely closed up set of sets) image, and those that have a large domain and small image, where “smallness” means belonging to some specified complex (a closed-down set).

arxiv-2202-05915.title: Collapsing Maps and Quasi-Isometries
arxiv-2202-05915.creator: Joshua Thompson, Davin Hemmila
arxiv-2202-05915.description: Abstract We introduce a generalization of the b-metric we call a (b,c)-metric. We show that if X X is a ( b , c ) (b,c) -metric space and ψ : X ⟶ Y \psi:X\longrightarrow Y is a quasi-isometry then Y Y is ( b , c ) (b,c) -metrizable.

arxiv-2206-14243.title: Effect of thermal gluon absorption and medium fluctuations on heavy flavour nuclear modification factor at RHIC and LHC energies
arxiv-2206-14243.creator: Ashik Ikbal Sheikh e1,addr1
arxiv-2206-14243.description: Abstract The presence of thermal gluons reduces the stimulated gluon emission off a heavy quark propagating in the quark-gluon plasma (QGP) while absorption causes reduction of the radiative energy loss. On the other hand, the chromo-electromagnetic field fluctuations present in the QGP lead to collisional energy gain of the heavy quark.

arxiv-2302-03145.title: Techniques to Improve Neural Math Word Problem Solvers
arxiv-2302-03145.creator: Youyuan Zhang
arxiv-2302-03145.description: Abstract Developing automatic Math Word Problem (MWP) solvers is a challenging task that demands the ability of understanding and mathematical reasoning over the natural language. Recent neural-based approaches mainly encode the problem text using a language model and decode a mathematical expression over quantities and operators iteratively.

arxiv-2305-13828.title: Comment on “Weak values and the past of a quantum particle”
arxiv-2305-13828.creator: Lev Vaidman
arxiv-2305-13828.description: Abstract In a recent paper, Hance, Rarity and Ladyman [Phys. Rev. Res. 5 , 023048 (2023)] criticized recent proposals connecting weak values and the past of a quantum particle. I argue that their conclusion follows from a conceptual error in understanding the approach to the past of the particle they discuss.

arxiv-2507-03663.title: LMC-induced Perturbations in the Milky Way Halo: I. HaloDance Simulation Suite and Observational Forecasts 2026 LMC-induced Perturbations in the Milky Way Halo: I. HaloDance Simulation Suite and Observational Forecasts – 2
arxiv-2507-03663.creator: Yanjun Sheng, Yuan-Sen Ting, Xiang-Xiang Xue
arxiv-2507-03663.description: Abstract The gravitational interaction between the Milky Way (MW) and Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) perturbs the MW halo’s density and kinematics, encoding information about both galaxies’ masses and structures. We present a suite of 2,848 high-resolution ( 10 7 10^{7} particles) N-body simulations that systematically vary the mass and shape of both galaxies’ haloes.

arxiv-2509-22660.title: Fairness for niche users and providers: algorithmic choice and profile portability
arxiv-2509-22660.creator: Elizabeth McKinnie, Anas Buhayh, Clement Canel, Robin Burke
arxiv-2509-22660.description: Abstract . Ensuring fair outcomes for multiple stakeholders in recommender systems has been studied mostly in terms of algorithmic interventions: building new models with better fairness properties, or using reranking to improve outcomes from an existing algorithm. What has rarely been studied is structural changes in the recommendation ecosystem itself.

arxiv-2510-16193.title: Operationalising Extended Cognition: Formal Metrics for Corporate Knowledge and Legal Accountability Conference: ACM Conference; Fifth ACM Symposium on Computer Science and Law (2026); Berkeley, California ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Computer systems organization Distributed architectures C
arxiv-2510-16193.creator: Elija Perrier
arxiv-2510-16193.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Elija Perrier. Corporate responsibility turns on notions of corporate mens rea , traditionally imputed from human agents. Yet these assumptions are under challenge as generative AI increasingly mediates enterprise decision-making. Building on the theory of extended cognition, we argue that in response corporate knowledge may be redefined as a dynamic capability, measurable by the efficiency of its information-access procedures and the validated reliability of their outputs.

arxiv-2510-20538.title: Quantifying robustness and locality of Majorana bound states in interacting systems
arxiv-2510-20538.creator: William Samuelson, Juan Daniel Torres Luna, Sebastian Miles, A. Mert Bozkurt, Martin Leijnse, Michael Wimmer, Viktor Svensson
arxiv-2510-20538.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by William Samuelson, Juan Daniel Torres Luna, Sebastian Miles, A. Mert Bozkurt, Martin Leijnse, Michael Wimmer, Viktor Svensson. Protecting qubits from perturbations is a central challenge in quantum computing. Topological superconductors with separated Majorana bound states (MBSs) provide a strong form of protection that only depends on the locality of perturbations.

arxiv-2601-11258.title: Knowledge is Not Enough: Injecting RL Skills for Continual Adaptation
arxiv-2601-11258.creator: Pingzhi Tang, Yiding Wang, Muhan Zhang
arxiv-2601-11258.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) face the “knowledge cutoff” challenge, where their frozen parametric memory prevents direct internalization of new information. While Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is commonly used to update model knowledge, it often updates factual content without reliably improving the model’s ability to use the newly incorporated information for question answering or decision-making.

pmc-11324868.title: Probing coherent quantum thermodynamics using a trapped ion
pmc-11324868.creator: O. Onishchenko, G. Guarnieri, P. Rosillo-Rodes, D. Pijn, J. Hilder, U. G. Poschinger, M. Perarnau-Llobet, J. Eisert, F. Schmidt-Kaler
pmc-11324868.description: Quantum thermodynamics is aimed at grasping thermodynamic laws as they apply to thermal machines operating in the deep quantum regime, where coherence and entanglement are expected to matter. Despite substantial progress, however, it has remained difficult to develop thermal machines in which such quantum effects are observed to be of pivotal importance.

pmc-11416828.title: A Narrative Review of the Efficacy and Safety of Oral Ketamine in Pediatric Sedation: A Critical Analysis of Current Evidence
pmc-11416828.creator: Lakshmi Naga Sai Sivani Dasari, Sanjot Ninave
pmc-11416828.description: Sedation in pediatric patients presents unique challenges due to their developmental and physiological differences compared to adults. Oral ketamine, a dissociative anesthetic, has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional sedatives, offering a non-invasive method for achieving sedation in children.

pmc-11643972.title: Polyacrylamide Hydrogel Containing Starch and Sugarcane Bagasse Ash: Synthesis, Characterisation, and Application in Cement Pastes and Mortars
pmc-11643972.creator: Ana Elizabete Nunes Pereira, Edson Araujo de Almeida, Fábio Rodrigo Kruger, Edson Cavalcanti da Silva-Filho, Edvani Curti Muniz
pmc-11643972.description: Internal curing is a process based on the addition of materials that function as water reservoirs in cementitious media. Superabsorbent hydrogels are an alternative that can be used as an internal curing agent, as they have the ability to absorb and release water in a controlled manner.

pmc-11676222.title: Systemic Embolism and Clinically Significant Bleeding Events in Older Adults with Nonvalvular Atrial Fibrillation After Treatment with Direct Oral Anticoagulants and Warfarin: A Retrospective Cohort Study in Japan
pmc-11676222.creator: Daichi Yaguchi, Shoji Sera, Akira Okada, Yuki Nishimura, Satoshi Tamaru, Naomi Nagai, Valeria Conti
pmc-11676222.description: Background/Objectives: Anticoagulant therapy, particularly the use of direct oral anticoagulant agents (DOACs), is recommended for patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF). This multicenter observational retrospective cohort study aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of DOACs compared to warfarin in Japanese patients aged 75 years and older with NVAF.

pmc-12567671.title: Genetic and Serological Analysis of H7N3 Avian Influenza Viruses in Mexico for Pandemic Risk Assessment
pmc-12567671.creator: Guadalupe Ayora-Talavera, Irma López-Martínez, Gisela Barrera-Badillo, Rodrigo Aparicio-Antonio, Nidia Aréchiga-Ceballos, Anita Aguirre-Barbosa, Rosa Maria Wong-Chew, Daniel Canul-Canul, Mario Solís-Hernández
pmc-12567671.description: Avian influenza A viruses pose ongoing threats to human and animal health, with H7 subtypes causing outbreaks globally. In Mexico, highly pathogenic H7N3 viruses have circulated in poultry since 2012, causing sporadic human infections. Here we analyzed genetic markers in hemagglutinin sequences from Mexican H7N3 isolates and conducted serological assays on human populations with poultry exposure.

pmc-12636799.title: Combined Anterior Latissimus Dorsi and Teres Major Tendon Transfer for Anterosuperior Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears in One-Arm Patients: A Case Report
pmc-12636799.creator: Chang Hee Baek, Chaemoon Lim, Jung Gon Kim, Bo Taek Kim
pmc-12636799.description: Introduction:One-arm patients experience a severe burden on the shoulder joint during daily activities, which lead to rotator cuff tears or degenerative joint disease over time. While anterosuperior irreparable rotator cuff tears (ASIRCTs) cause severe shoulder pain and functional impairments, surgeons face challenges due to the lack of a clear treatment protocol.

pmc-12651309.title: Nanofiber-Enabled Rapid and Non-Destructive Sensors for Meat Quality and Shelf-Life Monitoring: A Review
pmc-12651309.creator: Karna Ramachandraiah, Elizabeth M Martin, Alya Limayem, Leiqing Pan
pmc-12651309.description: The meat industry faces significant economic losses and environmental impacts due to spoilage and waste, much of which results from inadequate, delayed, or inefficient quality assessment. Traditional methods used for assessing meat quality are often time-consuming, labor-intensive, and lack the ability to provide real-time information, making them insufficient for modern supply chains that demand safety, freshness, and minimal waste.

pmc-13169562.title: Gender dynamics affecting women’s uptake of maternal health service in agrarian and pastoral settings in Ethiopia: a community-based cross-sectional study
pmc-13169562.creator: Agumasie Semahegn, Gizachew Tadele Tiruneh, Alemnesh Hailemariam Mirkuzie, Mesele Damte Argaw, Nebreed Fesseha, Mikiyas Teferi, Hillina Tadesse, Addis Girma, Mebrie Belete, Chala Tesfaye, Muluken Dessalegn Muluneh, Sintayehu Abebe Woldie, Meskerem Abebaw, Rediet Daniel, Zemzem Mohammed, Yibeltal Kif
pmc-13169562.description: BackgroundLack of access to essential maternal health service remains a significant public health challenge in low-income countries. Gender dynamics play a critical role in determining women’s access to and use of maternal health services. We assessed the influence of gender dynamics on women’s use of maternal health services in Ethiopia.

pmc-13298466.title: Nuclear Transfer Perturbs Genomic Balance
pmc-13298466.creator: Eryk Andreas, Justin C. St John
pmc-13298466.description: Background: The transfer of a nucleus from one oocyte to another offers patients harbouring high levels of mitochondrial DNA mutation and sufferers of frequent fertilisation failure or early embryonic arrest the potential to have healthy children. However, a small amount of mtDNA is carried over with the nucleus as the transfer takes place.

pmc-13552911.title: Genetic evidence and cross-species functional characterization implicate CNN2 in age-related macular degeneration susceptibility
pmc-13552911.creator: Fei-Fei Cheng, Hao Mou, Zhenyu Liu, Chang-Jun Zhang, You-Yuan Zhuang, Zhen Wu, Xin-Ran Wen, Angli Xue, Xiao Zhang, Jian Yang, Zi-Bing Jin
pmc-13552911.description: SignificanceAge-related macular degeneration (AMD) is the most common cause of irreversible vision loss among older adults and is projected to affect approximately 288 million people worldwide by 2040. Identifying the genes and cellular mechanisms underlying established AMD risk loci is essential for understanding disease pathogenesis and facilitating therapeutic development.
